name: Zing
niche: A craft energy drink and lemonade brand

seo.title: Zing — sugar-free craft energy drinks in Tashkent
seo.description: Six flavours of natural energy: green tea, guarana, juice, no sugar. 250 ml for 14,000 UZS, delivered across Tashkent in 60 minutes.
seo.answer: Zing is a Tashkent brand of sugar-free craft energy drinks: caffeine from green tea and guarana, real juice, 15 kcal per can. A 250 ml can costs 14,000 UZS, a 12-pack 150,000 UZS; delivery across Tashkent takes 60 minutes and is free from 150,000 UZS.

listing.description: A website for a drinks brand, FMCG product or product launch. The product at the centre turns as you scroll, endless type lines, flavour cards with prices and where to buy.

sections.title: Wakes you up. Never lies.
sections.subtitle: A craft energy drink made with green tea and guarana. Zero sugar, real juice and exactly as much caffeine as a double espresso.

sections.label: Flavours
sections.title: Six flavours, zero compromise
sections.intro: Every can is 250 ml with 80 mg of caffeine from green tea and guarana, sweetened with stevia and erythritol.

items.title: Grapefruit Kick
items.text: Pink grapefruit and lime. Just bitter enough to wake you up.

items.title: Lime Rush
items.text: Lime, mint and a pinch of salt — like lemonade after football.

items.title: Berry Riot
items.text: Raspberry, cherry and hibiscus. Sour, bright, loud.

items.title: Blue Volt
items.text: Blueberry and butterfly pea flower — it changes colour over ice.

items.title: Mango Sun
items.text: Mango, passion fruit and ginger for those who need some warmth.

items.title: Tarhun Zero
items.text: The tarragon soda of your childhood, minus the sugar and dyes.

sections.label: Why Zing
sections.title: An energy drink you can drink without reading the label in horror
sections.text: We brew Zing in a small facility in Tashkent: real juice, plant-based caffeine, no taurine for the sake of taurine. Batches are small, so the taste is the same every time.

items.quote: Switched from regular energy drinks to Grapefruit Kick — same buzz, no jitters in the evening.
items.author: Behzod

items.quote: Blue Volt is the most photogenic drink in our coffee shop. Guests order it for the colour and stay for the taste.
items.author: Madina

items.quote: Finally, a sugar-free energy drink that doesn’t taste like a pharmacy.
items.author: Sasha

items.q: How much caffeine is in one can?
items.a: 80 mg per 250 ml — roughly a double espresso. The caffeine comes from green tea extract and guarana. We don’t recommend more than three cans a day.
Stevia and erythritol. Sugar is 0 g; the 15 kcal per can come from the juice.

items.q: How much is it and how do I order?
items.a: A can costs 14,000–15,000 UZS; a 12-pack in any flavours is 150,000 UZS. Order via our Telegram bot or by phone.
Within Tashkent in 60 minutes, 10:00 to 22:00. Delivery is 15,000 UZS, free from 150,000 UZS.
No. Zing is a caffeinated energy drink: not recommended for children or pregnant or breastfeeding women.

items.q: Do you supply cafés and shops?
items.a: Yes, wholesale pricing starts at 5 packs. Write to hi@zing.uz and we’ll send the price list and terms within a day.

sections.label: Where to buy
sections.title: Grab one cold or order it home
sections.text: Our flagship store on Nukus is open every day, and delivery across Tashkent takes an hour.
